deadEnd.reason: Delivery-address gate cannot be satisfied by a proxy fill. Both address widgets (#HomeAddressAutocomplete on the home page, [data-testid="AddressAutocompleteField"] in the post-add-to-cart dialog) are controlled React comboboxes backed by a places-autocomplete: a programmatic fill is cleared by the page's own re-render, so the field reads empty immediately after and no suggestion list is produced. Signing in does not bypass it - the same dialog reappears after add-to-cart on a logged-in account with no stored address. Checkout is unreachable, so the payment surface was never observed.

gotchas: Cloudflare Turnstile interstitial on first load of the storefront - full block, zero page content, cleared only via challenge handoff to the account owner. Direct /store/<slug>/ URLs loaded without a challenge afterwards.

Login works and is worth recording: email [data-anchor-id="IdentityLoginPageEmailField"] plus input[type="password"] ([data-anchor-id="IdentityLoginPagePasswordField"]) on the same step, submitted with #login-submit-button. Enter on the password field does NOT submit. No MFA was presented.
Sign In controls on the storefront are not clickable (hit test times out); go straight to identity.doordash.com/auth instead.

Menu items expose no stable item selector. Reach one via its price text and take the nearest ancestor carrying @data-item-id / @data-anchor-id / @role=button. The dialog's add button is [data-anchor-id="AddToCartButtonSeoOptimization"].
notes: Recon only - no payment attempted and no card token filled. Gateway is commonly reported as Stripe but this run never reached the card surface, so platform is recorded as custom rather than assumed.
